grammar.summary: 本课学习一般过去时与问路指路表达。

points.title: 不规则动词过去式
points.explanation: go→went、say→said、see→saw、take→took 需逐个记忆。本课叙述昨日经历全部使用过去式。

examples.en: Last week Mrs. Mills went to London.
examples.cn: 上周 Mills 太太去了伦敦。
她自言自语道：'我迷路了。'

points.title: 问路与指路
points.explanation: Excuse me. Where is King Street? / Go along this road, then turn left. 指路动词短语直接用祈使句。

examples.en: Take the first turning on the right.
